new_candidates.body:
### Intro

Hi!

I just finished my PhD at Inria Scool (France), I use MuJoCo for my research on Reinforcement Learning.


### My setup

mujoco 3.17.0, mujoco-mjx 3.17.0 (Python API), warp-lang 1.12.1, jax 0.11.2, Python 3.12.8, macOS 15.7.4 on Apple M4 Pro (arm64), CPU only.

### What's happening? What did you expect?

`import mujoco.mjx` raises a `TypeError`, instead of falling back to the JAX backend, when the installed warp-lang is older than the bundled mujoco_warp needs. I expected the import to succeed and MJX to use the JAX backend, as it does when warp-lang is not installed.

Where (main):
- [mjx/warp/__init__.py#L36-L42](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/a6289c13780bfb876d496bf76ba9ac6a91b50760/mjx/mujoco/mjx/warp/__init__.py#L36-L42) always tries to import the bundled mujoco_warp, and catches only `ImportError` and `RuntimeError`:

```python
  try:
    from mujoco.mjx.third_party import mujoco_warp
    from mujoco.mjx.third_party.mujoco_warp._src import types as mjwp_types
    from mujoco.mjx.third_party.mujoco_warp._src import io as mjwp_io
  except (ImportError, RuntimeError) as e:
    print('Failed to import mujoco_warp:', e)
    pass
```

- [mujoco_warp/_src/solver.py#L1700](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/a6289c13780bfb876d496bf76ba9ac6a91b50760/mjx/mujoco/mjx/third_party/mujoco_warp/_src/solver.py#L1700) uses `@wp.kernel(grid_stride=True)`, which warp-lang 1.12.1 rejects with a `TypeError` at import time.

The `warp` extra pins `warp-lang==1.18.0` ([mjx/pyproject.toml#L38-L41](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/a6289c13780bfb876d496bf76ba9ac6a91b50760/mjx/pyproject.toml#L38-L41)), but nothing stops another package from bringing an older one. For example, MuJoCo Playground 0.2.0 declares `mujoco-mjx>=3.6.0` and `warp-lang>=1.11`, so a resolver can pick exactly this pair. Then `import mujoco.mjx` fails, even for users who only need the JAX backend. The docs' `pip install mujoco-mjx[warp]` avoids this; here the older warp-lang comes from another package. Related, but the other way round: #2894 (a warp-lang too new for `impl='warp'`).

A possible fix is to catch any exception from the bundled import:

```diff
     from mujoco.mjx.third_party.mujoco_warp._src import io as mjwp_io
-  except (ImportError, RuntimeError) as e:
+  except Exception as e:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
+    # e.g. TypeError when warp-lang is older than the bundled mujoco_warp needs.
     print('Failed to import mujoco_warp:', e)
```

With this change applied to a local copy of 3.17.0, the import succeeds with warp-lang 1.12.1, prints the message, and `mjx.step` runs on the JAX backend. Naming the required warp-lang version in the message could also help. I'm happy to send a PR.

### Steps for reproduction

1. Install mujoco-mjx 3.17.0 together with warp-lang 1.12.1 (and jax).
2. Run the code below.
3. The import fails:

```
  File ".../mujoco/mjx/warp/__init__.py", line 37, in <module>
    from mujoco.mjx.third_party import mujoco_warp
  ...
  File ".../mujoco/mjx/third_party/mujoco_warp/_src/solver.py", line 1677, in <module>
    @wp.kernel(grid_stride=True)
     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
TypeError: kernel() got an unexpected keyword argument 'grid_stride'
```

Without warp-lang installed, the same import prints the two "Failed to import" messages and succeeds.

### Minimal model for reproduction

Not needed: the error happens at `import mujoco.mjx`, before any model is loaded.

### Code required for reproduction

```python
import importlib.metadata as md

for dist in ("mujoco", "mujoco-mjx", "warp-lang", "jax"):
    try:
        print(dist, md.version(dist))
    except md.PackageNotFoundError:
        print(dist, "not installed")

import mujoco.mjx  # noqa: E402,F401

print("import mujoco.mjx: ok")
```

### Confirmations

- [x] I searched the [latest documentation](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html) thoroughly before posting.
- [x] I searched previous [Issues](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/discussions), I am certain this has not been raised before.
new_candidates.title: `import mujoco.mjx` fails with TypeError when warp-lang is too old

new_candidates.body:
Because of this code:
https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/blob/45e248614f64d6d8ed1ed35763d2329357be981a/controller_manager/controller_manager/controller_manager_services.py#L357-L362

only YAML files built in one of the following form works:
```YAML
controller:
  ros__args:
     dummy: 0

/ns/controller:
  ros__args:
     dummy: 0

/**/controller:
  ros__args:
     dummy: 0

/**/ns/controller:
  ros__args:
     dummy: 0
```

but if you have perfeclty valid:
```yaml
/ns:
  controller:
     ros__args:
        dummy: 0

ns:
  controller:
    ros__args:
      dummy: 0
```

the YAML file gets discarded.
new_candidates.title: `ros2 control load_controller` discards valid YAML files
